name: Faenare
page: Background Booklet pp. 6–10, Table 3 and the Faenare combat and windsinger rules
notes: Background Booklet p. 6 supplies 120 ft (40 ft) ground and 360 ft (120 ft) flight, natural attacks and the mature racial defenses. Table 3 sets Teren at 0 XP with 2d8, natural AC 6 and two first-level slots.
P. 5 uses actual Hit Dice for a low-level creature hero’s save bracket. The ordinary p. 6 monster listing uses Elf 3. Both Elf 2 and Elf 3 have the same target numbers in Mentzer Basic.

PC2 calls the lightning protection permanent but leaves the Companion spell’s level-based damage allowance and refresh unspecified. Use a continuing ward that absorbs two dice per separate lightning attack for this 2 HD NPC. Treat a continuing lightning effect as the same attack.
The windsinger prepares one windsong and one clerical healing spell in the two first-level slots. The double Singing skill allocation applies when using general skills.

name: Skygnome
page: Background Booklet pp. 10–12, Table 4 and skygnome abilities I–VI, IX and XII
notes: Table 4 level 2 at 4,000 XP gives 3d8 and ability IV for skygnomes. The air-based save remains +1 and the first sky-sense increase occurs at level 3.
Mentzer Basic gives leather AC 7 and Dexterity 16 gives a −2 AC adjustment. With no shield, Nell has AC 5, or AC 4 against a larger-than-human opponent.
PC2’s Dunbar example also lists the 3 HD attack bracket and gnome movement at 60 ft (20 ft), with the 90 ft infravision, basic aerial sense and accidental fall save.
The portrait shows Nell’s wrench. She also keeps a mundane war hammer in her toolkit.

name: Gremlin
page: Background Booklet pp. 13–16, Table 5 and the chaotic-aura, hiding, fumble and Leg Whip rules
notes: Table 5 level 3 at 21,000 XP has 2d8+2, 14 ft aura, +1 enemy saves, −2 foe fumbles, 50% Hide in Crannies, +2 defense against mental/illusion magic and ability VI (Leg Whip). PC2’s Beazley combat notes supply ground move at 120 ft (40 ft per round).
Expert’s monster chart puts 2d8+2 in the 2+ to 3 bracket. Use two dice for Elf save progression, following PC2 p. 5 and the distinction between dice and flat HP.

Ability V lists the shorter jump distances as horizontal a second time. The paired horizontal and vertical labels in ability III support reading the second pair as vertical. Big and strong targets receive the ability’s +2 save bonus in addition to the normal tier bonus.
For the example unattended prop, 75% is the table’s simple-outcome benchmark. Interpret PC2’s natural-01 failure with an upper successful percentile interval.

name: Nagpa
page: Background Booklet pp. 20–22, Table 7, kariwa, special abilities and Languages and Knowledge Skills
notes: Level 1 at 300,000 XP has 10d8, AC 4 and +2 on its saves. PC2 Background Booklet p. 5 directly gives THAC0 10 for that creature-hero tier. Match its save bracket to Magic-User 10.
PC2 Adventure Booklet’s Horrobin combat notes confirm the standard 120 ft (40 ft) move, bite option and 1d8 damage. Unlike that NPC, Avar is Neutral, so corruption does not apply.
P. 22 refers back to the Mentzer Basic clerical Light reversal and second-level Magic-User Phantasmal Force. Each innate effect has its own three-use daily limit at this tier.
